content:
Maya Ortiz: Quick pass at routing logic for marketplace -> SI bundles. Want to lock rules for matching, SLAs, and announcement gating. Sharing CSV + sweep rule below.
Gabe Li: Nice. Can we make the dedupe score explicit? e.g. match_score >= 0.80 -> auto-stitch to existing SFDC account, 0.60-0.79 -> queue for SDR review.
Nikhil Rao: +1. Also suggest we surface 'bundle_type' (software-only, hardware-bundle, managed-service) because announcement windows differ.
Maya Ortiz: Agreed. Proposed claim SLAs: high_priority = 48h, normal = 72h. If unclaimed after 7d -> notify marketplace owner and partnerships lead.
Gabe Li: For co-sell credit we need a composite: credit_score = max(SI_priority * 0.6, partner_intensity * 0.4) and record `co_sell_credit_pct` on the claim. Keep it simple in SFDC.
Nikhil Rao: Ops notes: require `nda_status` and `legal_clearance` flags before any joint-marketing asset can be published. Also add `embargo_days_required` default 14 for enterprise, 7 for hardware-bundle, override with PartnerOps signoff.
Maya Ortiz: Pasting CSV header for the mapping ingest (will be pushed from marketplace export):
```
marketplace_id,lead_email,company_name,company_domain,match_score,bundle_type,si_candidate,si_assigned,co_sell_credit_pct,nda_status,legal_clearance,embargo_days_required,initial_lead_ts,claimed_at
```
Gabe Li: For the weekly sweep job use this pseudo-SQL to flag stale leads:
```
UPDATE marketplace_leads
SET status='escalated', escalation_reason='unclaimed'
WHERE claimed_at IS NULL
  AND created_at < now() - interval '72 hours'
  AND priority <> 'high';
```
Nikhil Rao: Also add an auto-escalation route for high_priority if unclaimed >48h -> ping #partnerships AND create SFDC task assigned to Partnerships queue.
PartnerOps (bot): Reminder: weekly marketplace sweep scheduled in 3 days. Will post summary to #partnerships.
Maya Ortiz: Announcement gating checklist (short): nda_status == 'signed', legal_clearance == 'yes', embargo window met, marketing contact assigned, joint press owner assigned, support on-call defined. Only then set `announce_flag=true`.
Gabe Li: For small hardware bundles we can allow embargo_days = 7 if PartnerOps approves; require marketing asset stub at time of approval.
Nikhil Rao: Technical handoff payload (what SI needs): expected qps, data residency notes, auth method, baseline runbook link. Add `tech_runbook_url` to the mapping if available.
Maya Ortiz: Decision items: 1) adopt match_score thresholds above, 2) claim SLA 48/72/7d auto-close/escalate, 3) add bundle_type + embargo rules, 4) record co_sell_credit_pct on claim. Who volunteers to draft the Playbook?
Gabe Li: I can draft the Playbook (claim flows + SFDC record examples) by EOD Wednesday.
Nikhil Rao: I'll add the sweep SQL, runbook template, and Integrations checklist.
Maya Ortiz: Thanks. @PartnerOps (bot) can you schedule a 30m review on Thursday morning and ping legal + marketing for gating review?
PartnerOps (bot): Scheduled: Partner routing + announce gates review Thursday 10:00am PT. Invites sent to @legal, @marketing, @partnerships.
Maya Ortiz: Perfect. Will upload the initial CSV schema + example rows to the shared drive and post link here after drafting.
Gabe Li: One more: ensure `si_assigned` TTL of 14 days for claims where SI is tentative; if SI doesn't engage, mark back to marketplace SDR and reduce co_sell_credit_pct by 25%.
Nikhil Rao: Noted. We'll codify that in the Playbook.
Maya Ortiz: Excellent. Closing loop: Playbook + schema + sweep rules -> review Thurs -> finalize and push to Integrations team for implementation. :white_check_mark:
